items.title: Chuck Mancuso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 10, 2013
items.q: So I did a thing with Blue Note and Riverside Records, and Art Blakey and Horace Silver and that stuff.

ctx.x: So I had a real nice career. And he loved to go to my basketball games. And he said, “You know on the court you’re about as tall as most of the guys but you play like you’re six-five.” “I love you Professor Tallmadge, you’re so nice.” But he had me teach for one week on the Contemporary Movement, this is 1964, so something on Blue Note Records. So I did a thing with Blue Note and Riverside Records, and Art Blakey and Horace Silver and that stuff. And that was cool. So a girl was in the class and she sat next to…
I’ll be darned. This was “The Jazz Brothers?”
